title: Controllable and lightweight federated learning method, system and detection method for privacy protection
assignee: Nanjing University of Posts and Telecommunications

pse.problem: The method and system aim to solve privacy protection issues in network traffic detection through distributed federated learning, where direct interaction with network data may result in privacy leakage.
pse.solution_function: The invention performs controllable and lightweight federated learning for privacy-preserving network traffic detection. It trains local models on each subnet node using a local dataset and predefined model and parameters. The local models are pruned to generate compressed snapshots, which are used to determine the global snapshot via weighted aggregation of other subnet nodes' snapshots. A global compression model is formed by pruning the output channels of each layer of the aggregated global model. Each subnet node then trains the global compression model using its local training set.
pse.solution_structure: The key components include subnet nodes, a preset model and parameters, adjustment factors for calculating output channels, compressed snapshots of local models, a benchmark snapshot, channel recovery threshold, aggregated global model, and global compression model.
pse.solution_implementation: 1. Each subnet node trains a local model based on its local dataset and predefined model/parameters. 2. Calculate adjustment factors for each layer of the local model to determine output channels that need pruning. 3. Generate compressed snapshots of the local model. 4. Determine the optimal sub-network node based on the number of data in its training set. 5. Use the benchmark snapshot, channel recovery threshold, and other subnet nodes' compressed snapshots to determine the global snapshot. 6. Perform weighted aggregation on the models of other subnet nodes to form an aggregated global model. 7. Prune the output channels of each layer of the aggregated global model to create a global compression model. 8. Each subnet node trains the global compression model using its local training set.
pse.effect: The solution provides privacy protection, lightweight processing for large-scale neural network models, and efficient distributed network traffic detection
